info.name: JU Meal Management API
info.description:
End-to-end contract tests for the JU Meal Management API.

Run it with `npm run test:api` against a migrated and seeded database. The runner supplies the demo credentials; see docs/development.md. Requests run in order because later folders depend on tokens, ids, and fixtures captured by earlier ones.
